leads.text:
We recorded over a thousand runs of Slay the Spire and its sequel for our recent benchmark, SpireClimb. Over the coming weeks, we'll publish them all on our YouTube channel, complete with subtitles showing the models' in-game thinking.

Check out the run that produced the clip:

https://t.co/sKi2VdOUIu

And the playlist where we're uploading all videos:

https://t.co/mZ1pnwXe16

Rather than being recorded live, the videos are reconstructed from the models’ play data (inputs and thinking).

We don't plan to update the playlist with videos from future models' runs on SpireClimb, but we hope this archive offers interesting insights into how current models play the game.

Bubble Talk: Tulips to Tech
Rational Dissent Episode 013
